definitions.explanation: The two points where the upper and lower lips meet.

examples.japanese: {口角|こうかく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上|あ}げる→上げる：02443_ageru⟧。
examples.english: Turn up the corners of your mouth.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧{口角|こうかく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{下|さ}がっている→下がる：01188_sagaru⟧。
examples.english: The corners of his mouth always turn down.

examples.japanese: ⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{撮|と}る→撮る：00760_toru⟧とき⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{口角|こうかく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧⟦{上|あ}げる→上げる：02443_ageru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{自然|しぜん}→自然：01423_shizen⟧な⟦{笑顔|えがお}→笑顔：01884_egao⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: When you have your photo taken, lifting the corners of your mouth a little gives a natural smile.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
- {口角|こうかく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上|あ}げる→上げる：02443_ageru⟧: to turn up the corners of the mouth, to smile slightly
- {口角|こうかく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{下|さ}がる→下がる：01188_sagaru⟧: the corners of the mouth turn down

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {口角|こうかく}⟦{泡|あわ}→泡：02175_awa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飛|と}ばす→飛ばす：02373_tobasu⟧: to argue heatedly (literally, to spray foam from the corners of the mouth)

WATCH OUT:
- Same reading as ⟦{降格|こうかく}→降格：04688_koukaku⟧ (demotion) and ⟦{広角|こうかく}→広角：17788_koukaku⟧ (wide-angle).
